name: Claude Remotion Skill
purpose: React-based programmatic video creation and animation system using Remotion.
capabilities: Modular UI components (UIFrame, StatReveal, TerminalAnimation, ComparisonSlide)

installation.instructions: Not installed in workspace. Blocked as a production dependency due to heavy Node/React build stack and memory overhead on 8 GB RAM.

compatibility.notes: Requires Node.js, Webpack/Babel bundler, and multi-process Chromium rendering which exceeds the 8 GB unified memory budget on Apple Silicon M2.

licensing.notes: Skill wrapper is MIT licensed. Remotion itself is source-available (not OSI): free for individuals, non-profits and for-profit organisations of up to 3 employees; a company licence is required above that.

security.notes: Runs npm build scripts and invokes Remotion CLI with background workers.

approval_evidence: Workspace Steward evaluation: Blocked as a production rendering dependency. HyperFrames + GSAP + Chromium provides superior rendering performance (<200 MB RAM vs >2 GB RAM in Remotion) and sub-second deterministic frame capture on Apple Silicon M2 8 GB. Reusable UI design patterns (UIFrame, StatReveal, TerminalAnimation) are documented for native GSAP adaptation. Re-evaluated 2026-11-24 for math and algorithm animation (docs/visual-engines.md): still blocked. It duplicates the HyperFrames frame renderer rather than adding a capability; its licence (remotion-dev/remotion LICENSE.md) is source-available, free for individuals and for-profit organisations of up to 3 employees, a paid company licence above that.
